issues.legal_issue: Whether criminal proceedings alleging matrimonial cruelty and related offences should be quashed when the allegations are vague, general, and lack material particulars or specific roles for the accused.
Whether criminal proceedings should be quashed when they are an abuse of process because they arise from and are intended to advance an essentially civil property dispute.
Whether the High Court may exercise its inherent power to quash criminal proceedings after a chargesheet has been filed.
